output_document.summary: Last quarter, a rate limit incident in Q3 2024 knocked several clients offline for 2-4 hours when the API threshold was lowered from 1000 to 500 requests per minute without proper advance warning. The postmortem identified three key lessons: (1) all limit changes require 72-hour advance notice to clients, (2) clients must have a documented escalation path for support, and (3) rate limit headers should be included in all API responses. These lessons emphasize the critical importance of clear communication, proper notification timing, and transparent rate limit visibility—all of which should be incorporated into the webhooks feature design to prevent similar disruptions.
